pageProps.title: Project Hail Mary
pageProps.review: Andy Weir's novel Project Hail Mary is a work with an interesting composition where the reader understands the situation along with the protagonist who lost his memory, standing out for its scientific meticulousness. It provides the best immersion through the meeting with the charming character Rocky and a moving narrative.
pageProps.description: I, who can't even remember my name, am the hope of mankind? A project to save the earth on the brink of extinction!
pageProps.content:
## Review I enjoyed reading it so much. I thought, 'So you can read such a thick book this fast.'
The composition where the protagonist, who lost his memory, and the reader, who knows nothing, start on the same line and gradually grasp the situation together was interesting and fun.
I think it's a work where the nerdiness of trying to think of everything through scientific reasoning and the author's scientific meticulousness stand out.
Readers who have read this book would have mobilized their imagination to create their own Rocky and imagined him saying ```Amaze! Amaze!```. My own Rocky is very cute!!
It's being made into a movie with a target release in 2026. ```Amaze! Amaze!```
